title: AI can combine mathematical ideas on a scale beyond individual human minds. But could it produce ideas likes Einstein?
summary: It once struggled to get simple sums right. But AI is now tackling tough mathematical problems like the Riemann hypothesis. How AI made this extraordinary leap. And why mathematicians should be "deeply worried."

title: Airline Norse Atlantic files for bankruptcy, succumbing to aviation fuel costs
summary: The low-cost airline was only founded a few years ago and had been struggling to turn a profit. The spike in aviation fuel prices caused by the war in Iran has now driven Norway's Norse Atlantic into bankruptcy.

title: Arsenic in the water: Thailand presses Myanmar over mining pollution
summary: Thailand is seeking to tackle river pollution stemming from rare earth mines in neighboring Myanmar. The two countries held joint talks this week as a "first step towards agreeing on the evidence."

title: As Gambia gears up for election, can Barrow secure a third term?
summary: President Adama Barrow is seeking a third term as Gambians vote on December 5. The election will test the opposition's appeal and the country's progress on democratic reform.

title: Canada: Supreme Court largely upholds Quebec secularism bill
summary: Quebec's government passed Bill 21 to ban religious symbols for public servants, arguing it was necessary to protect its secularist society. Critics argue the bill weakens legal protections for fundamental rights.

title: Divisions deepen between EU member states after tense budget summit
summary: An EU leaders summit on the bloc's seven-year budget fell apart amid divisions over how to fund Ukraine. The budget proposal also includes a 3% tax on US tech companies, in a bid for the EU to generate additional funds.

title: Dutch authorities seize 26 critically endangered turtles from luggage of passenger bound for Hong Kong
summary: The tiny Vallarta mud turtle was only discovered in 2018. It's critically endangered with around 300 thought to live in the wild. Almost one tenth of that number were stashed in a traveler's luggage, bound in duct tape.

title: Duterte's ICC trial: What is at stake for the Philippines?

title: France seeks German man in Channel migrant boat probe
summary: A German businessman is accused of supplying equipment to smugglers organizing migrant crossings from France to the United Kingdom. However, he can't face formal charges until he is extradited to France.
